# EmptyState

What a view shows when it has nothing to show yet: a picture, a short header, one line saying what goes here, and the action that fills it. It invites; it does not apologize. - **image** is a slot for an Illustration or any picture. Without it, `icon` (a Font Awesome Free solid name) stands in. Both are decorative. - **header** is a heading one level below the section that holds the EmptyState, so it joins the page's outline. - **primaryAction** is one filled Button; **secondaryAction** an optional outlined one after it. - **spacing** `default` centers in a view on Heading/medium 20; `compact` fits a table body or a card on Heading/small 16 with a smaller picture. Pass it to a Table's `emptyState` slot.

Also asked as: no data, zero state, blank slate.

**Import:** `import { EmptyState } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/messaging/EmptyState/EmptyState.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/messaging/EmptyState/EmptyState.stories.jsx` — Overview, WithIcon, Default, Compact, InATable, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused

## Usage

Use `EmptyState` when a view, panel, card or table has no content yet, in place
of a blank area or a bare "No results". It carries a picture, a header, one line
and one primary action.

Use a `SectionMessage`, not an `EmptyState`, for a failure.

### Spacing guidance

| Spacing | When to use |
| --- | --- |
| Default | A whole view or panel. The header is Heading/medium 20. |
| Compact | A table body or a card. The header is Heading/small 16, with a smaller picture. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Keep the header short and specific to what is missing. | Apologize or blame: "Oops, nothing here." |
| Use the description for context that helps someone decide what to do. | Repeat the header in the description. |
| Make the primary action name the next step: "Add student". | Use a generic label such as "Continue". |
| Add a secondary action only for a real alternative, such as importing. | Add a second action just to fill space. |

## Best practices

### Use default spacing for a whole view. {#use-default-spacing-for-a-whole-view}

Compact spacing is for a table body or a card.

Do: Default spacing fills a view or panel.
Don't: Compact spacing leaves a full view cramped.

### Lead with one filled action. {#lead-with-one-filled-action}

The second action is outlined and never stands alone.

Do: A filled action leads.
Don't: An outlined action with nothing to lead.

### Invite with the next step. {#invite-with-the-next-step}

Say what goes here and what to do, in a warm voice. Never apologize.

Do: What goes here and what to do.
Don't: A cold label with no way forward.

### Fill a Table with it, not around it. {#fill-a-table-with-it-not-around-it}

The Table keeps its header row and the EmptyState takes the body.

Do: An EmptyState in the Table's emptyState.
Don't: An EmptyState under a Table with an empty body.

## Accessibility

- **A real heading.** The header is one level below the section that holds the
  EmptyState, so it joins the page outline.
- **Decorative picture.** The image and icon are hidden from screen readers; the
  words carry the meaning.
- **Contrast.** Header and description use the text roles, which pass in every
  color mode.
- **Reflow.** The text wraps inside a column no wider than
  `--section-min-width-main`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `header` | node | — | What this view is, as a heading: "No students yet". |
| `description` | node | — | One line on what goes here and what to do, in an inviting voice. |
| `image` | node | — | Picture slot, such as an Illustration. Takes the place of `icon`. |
| `icon` | string | — | A Font Awesome Free solid name, such as "user-group", shown when there is no `image`. |
| `primaryAction` | node | — | The one action that fills the view: a filled Button. |
| `secondaryAction` | node | — | An optional second action: an outlined Button. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | `default` for a view or panel; `compact` for a table body or a card. |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
